verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents locations and zones for managing multiple readers across physical sites, and readers must be registered to a location. Readers can be ordered, registered, configured, and monitored from the Dashboard, so per-location devices are clearly covered. However, nothing shows settings scoped per location or reporting broken out by location. Missing for 10: documented per-location settings/configuration, per-location reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-site operation.
